body.name: \mathcal I_{\le3}^{(W)}
body.construction: \[S_W=\{(W_2^{\mathrm{el}})^k:k\in\mathbb N_0\},\qquad \mathcal I_{\le3}^{(W)}=S_W^{-1}\mathcal I_{\le3}\subset S_W^{-1}\mathbb F[\beta,\mathbf m].\] Localization therefore means inversion of the single observable polynomial \(W_2^{\mathrm{el}}\); its contraction to \(\mathbb F[\beta,\mathbf m]\) is the saturation \(\mathcal I_{\le3}:(W_2^{\mathrm{el}})^\infty\). Extension afterward to \(K_{\mathrm{obs}}[\beta]\) inverts every nonzero observable class.
